geometry-dash-back-on-track.title: Geometry Dash Back On Track
geometry-dash-back-on-track.slogan: Experience the iconic rhythm-based platforming challenge
geometry-dash-back-on-track.description: Geometry Dash Back On Track is an iconic level in the popular rhythm-based platforming game, Geometry Dash. It serves as the second level in the main game and provides players with an exciting and addictive gaming experience. In Back On Track, players navigate through a series of challenging obstacles and geometric environments. The level features a vibrant and colorful visual design, with neon-like backgrounds and pulsating platforms that add to the immersive experience.
